tools.name: dataset_info
tools.description: What data is loaded: source, snapshot month, row counts, field meanings and caveats. Call first if unsure what the tools cover.

tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Find companies/establishments matching filters. Filters (all optional, combined with AND): cnae (CNAE code or prefix, e.g. '4711' or '47', list ok; add include_secondary to also match secondary activities), cnae_secao (letter A-U), uf, municipio (name as in Receita, accents ignored), municipio_codig

tools.name: count_companies
tools.description: Count companies or establishments, optionally grouped by one or two fields. Filters (all optional, combined with AND): cnae (CNAE code or prefix, e.g. '4711' or '47', list ok; add include_secondary to also match secondary activities), cnae_secao (letter A-U), uf, municipio (name as in Receita, accen

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: One company by CNPJ (14 digits, with or without punctuation; or the 8-digit root to get the matriz): registration, company data, Simples/MEI, address and contacts, secondary CNAEs, partners (with names), and how many establishments the company has.

tools.name: list_partners
tools.description: Partners (socios) of one company by CNPJ root or full CNPJ: names, type, role (qualificacao), entry date, age band. CPFs are masked by Receita. faixa_etaria: 1 = 0-12, 2 = 13-20, 3 = 21-30, 4 = 31-40, 5 = 41-50, 6 = 51-60, 7 = 61-70, 8 = 71-80, 9 = over 80, 0 = not applicable.

tools.name: search_partners
tools.description: Find the companies a person or entity is a partner of, by name. Exact (accent-insensitive, case-insensitive) match on the partner name by default; set contains=true for a substring match (uf required). Optionally narrow with cpf_middle (the 6 digits Receita publishes, e.g. '240659') because the same

tools.name: companies_at_address
tools.description: Establishments registered at one address, by CEP (8 digits), optionally narrowed by street text, number, municipio or uf. Use it to find companies sharing an address.

tools.name: lookup_codes
tools.description: Look up Receita's code tables by text or code. kind: cnae (activity), natureza_juridica (legal form), municipio, motivo (reason for status), qualificacao (partner role), pais. CNAE text returns ranked candidates using exact descriptions, curated everyday aliases, word matches and spelling suggestion

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "search_companies" is 2171 chars, far longer than this server's median (327). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_companies · Private data: search_companies, get_company · Public sink: search_companies.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_companies · Private data: search_companies, get_company · Public sink: search_companies

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
